speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The Singapore economy is restructuring towards higher value-added activities while adjusting to a more moderate rate of economic growth in line with slowing labour force growth.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: The financial sector is integral to Singapore’s growth as a competitive economy, a globally connected city, and a Smart Nation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: As an integrated regulator and supervisor of the financial sector, MAS will safeguard the stability of Singapore’s financial system while ensuring that our regulatory frameworks remain supportive of innovation.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will work with the financial industry to advance financial technology (FinTech) innovations, including those aimed at more convenient and lower-cost services for consumers, support Asia’s development while being a leading hub in global finance, and serving the growth of the Singapore economy.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Asia is expected to remain economically the most dynamic region in the world, with demand for financial services growing robustly with growing infrastructural needs and rising affluence.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will implement strategies to facilitate the growth of infrastructure financing, trade financing and enterprise financing to support the region’s development.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will support industry efforts to increase insurance penetration in the region and catalyse effective disaster risk financing solutions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will also strengthen our capital market infrastructure to boost liquidity and price discovery in the foreign exchange, debt and equity markets.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will work with the industry to enhance connectivity with our key regional markets, including China, India and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: With Singapore chairing ASEAN in 2018, MAS will work with fellow ASEAN member states and industry partners to pursue initiatives to achieve sustainable growth, boost economic resilience and foster innovation in the region.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS is also exploring innovative trade finance connectivity and cross-border real-time payment linkages with key partners in the region.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS has been at the forefront globally in the use of regulatory sandboxes to encourage experimentation and will enhance this approach.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will strengthen the payments infrastructure to enable real-time, convenient electronic payment transfers.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will work with all stakeholders to help equip financial sector professionals with specialist skills and the expertise to leverage technology and data.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: More Professional Conversion Programmes will be developed in various areas of specialisation, geared to emerging job roles.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will work with the Institute of Banking and Finance and tripartite partners to set up a dedicated career centre to provide job matching and placement assistance.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will continue to enhance its financial regulatory framework to help ensure stability amidst volatile global financial markets as well as new and emerging risks.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will strengthen cyber resilience across the industry and leverage technology to enhance our supervision and enforcement capabilities.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: MAS will increasingly employ data analytics to sharpen its surveillance of risks in major financial institutions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: We will employ advanced techniques, such as network analysis and text and voice analytics, to support our investigation and enforcement actions.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Beyond setting rules, MAS is working to foster a culture that motivates ethical behaviour and responsible risk-taking in the financial industry.

speaker: The Deputy Prime Minister and Minister-in-charge of the Monetary Authority of Singapore (Mr Tharman Shanmugaratnam)
text: Culture and conduct weaknesses underlie many cases of misconduct, poor governance and excessive risk-taking.
